forgot_intro: Enter your username or email address. If it matches an account, we'll send a link to reset your password.
forgot_email_off_hint: Email delivery isn't configured, so a reset link can't be sent right now. Please ask an administrator to reset your password.
reset_intro: Set a new password for your account. This link works once and then expires.
reset_policy_hint: At least 12 characters. Avoid common words and keyboard patterns.
su_intro: Register below. An administrator will then place you into your team, after which you'll have full access.
su_sso_help: One click with your company account — no password to create. You'll be placed by an administrator afterwards.
pend_body: Thanks for registering. An administrator now needs to add you to your site, department and service and assign your supervisor or manager. Once that is done you will be able to sign in with full access — please check back later.
notice_session_expired: Your session ended after a period of inactivity. Please sign in again.
profile_email_needs_password: To change your e-mail address, enter your current password.
profile_email_bad_password: Current password is incorrect: your e-mail address was not changed.
profile_email_no_local_password: Your account signs in through SSO only: it has no local password to confirm this change. Ask an administrator to change your e-mail address.
profile_current_password: Current password (required to change the e-mail address)
email_changed_subject: Your sign-in e-mail address was changed
email_changed_body:
Hello {{name}},

The e-mail address on your account has just been replaced with: {{newEmail}}.
Password-reset links will now be sent to that address.

If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.
login_sso_org: Sign in with your organisation account
login_sso_help: Sign-in uses your work account (single sign-on).
login_breakglass_banner: Reserved for the super administrator (emergency access). Every other account signs in with SSO.
sso_choose_intro: Your identity is linked to several accounts. Continue as:
sso_choose_employee_hint: Your personal space: assessments, goals, team.
sso_choose_admin_hint: The administration account: two-factor authentication may be requested.
login_sso_degraded: SSO sign-in is switched on but no provider is available. Contact your administrator; only the super administrator emergency access works.
sso_enrol_intro: Your administrator account has no two-factor authentication yet. Enter the one-time code a super administrator gave you: you will then set up your authenticator app.
login_sso_first_help: Can't sign in for the first time? Contact {{contact}}.
login_sso_not_linked: Your {{provider}} account is recognised, but it is not yet linked to {{app}}. Contact {{contact}} and give your employee number.
ssoinv_intro: From now on you sign in to {{app}} with {{account}}, the one you already use for your other work tools. Your old {{app}} password is no longer used.
ssoinv_intro_ms: From now on you sign in to {{app}} with {{account}}, the same one you use for Windows or Outlook. Your old {{app}} password is no longer used.
ssoinv_benefits: One password only: your company account’s. No {{app}} password to remember or reset any more, and a better-protected sign-in.
ssoinv_step3_upn: Enter your company login: {{upn}}, then your password.
ssoinv_step3: Enter your usual company login, then your password.
ssoinv_shared_pc: Shared computer: when asked “Stay signed in?”, answer “No”. When you are done, click “Sign out”, then close every browser window.
ssoinv_never_password: We will never ask for your password by e-mail.
ssoinv_admin: Administrator account: if your company sign-in did not already ask you for a second verification (a code, or an approval on your phone), you will then be asked for a 6-digit code (authenticator app). Not set up yet? Follow the activation screen or ask the super administrator for an enrolment code.
ssoinv_security_notice: During a first sign-in, {{account}} has just been linked to your {{app}} access. If this was not you, contact {{contact}} immediately.
login_breakglass_link_exc: Password sign-in (super administrator or authorised account)
login_breakglass_banner_exc: Reserved for the super administrator and the accounts they authorised. Every other account signs in with SSO.
ssoann_body: From {{date}}, you will sign in to {{app}} with {{account}}, the one you already use for your other work tools.
ssoann_body_ms: From {{date}}, you will sign in to {{app}} with {{account}}, the same one you use for Windows or Outlook.
ssoann_nothing_yet: Until then nothing changes. On that day you will receive a message explaining how to sign in.
ssochg_title: Signing in with your company account: what changes
ssochg_later: Your account will soon switch to signing in with your company account. The date is not set yet: until then nothing changes, keep signing in as usual. You will be told before the change.
ssochg_none: No sign-in change is planned for your account. Keep signing in as usual.
ssochg_error: This information cannot be shown right now. Try again later or contact your administrator.
pw_strength_hint: Tip: four or more unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess. Paste from a password manager works.
throttled_wait: Too many attempts. Please try again in {{wait}}.
mfa_grace_notice_one: Two-factor authentication becomes mandatory for your account on {{date}} (in {{count}} day). Turn it on now from “Two-factor authentication”.
mfa_grace_notice_other: Two-factor authentication becomes mandatory for your account on {{date}} (in {{count}} days). Turn it on now from “Two-factor authentication”.
